headline: API key authentication goes live on protected endpoints as live reserve tracking reaches 126 coins.
fieldNotes: Access control was the week's structural change: protected endpoints now require an API key, with rotation, expiry, and an audit log behind it. Reserve work continued in parallel, adding issuer balance sheets from Frax and Block Analitica. Liquidity scoring started weighing pool depth against each coin's size, and the site gained a weekly changelog, a public status history, and collapsible navigation.

summary.label: API key authentication
summary.description: Full auth gate on protected endpoints with key rotation, audit logging, dual-pepper hashing, and rate limiting

summary.label: Liquidity Score v5.0
summary.description: Size-aware scoring formulas use market cap to judge depth relative to supply, with component weights reset to 30/20/20/20/10

summary.label: Live reserve expansion
summary.description: USDSC, satUSD, USDai, Anzen USDz, Liquity v1 LUSD, frxUSD, eUSD, feUSD, USSD, and Honey go live; DAI and USDS move to Block Analitica, bringing coverage to 126 coins

summary.label: Richer risk surfaces
summary.description: Non-USD market share charts, blacklist status distribution, and a treasury stable exposure view covering 18 issuer treasuries

summary.label: Safety Score v6.93
summary.description: Steeper peg multiplier and an active-depeg grade cap

summary.label: Broader stablecoin coverage
summary.description: BUCK added, Base Dollar listed as upcoming, and USD.AI and sUSDai tracked separately, bringing tracking to 188 stablecoins

summary.label: Pipeline reliability
summary.description: Hardened pricing consensus, reserve sync, redemption backstops, depeg recovery, and cron orchestration

summary.label: Status page upgrades
summary.description: Public status history API with uptime bar and transition timeline, request-source attribution, D1 usage telemetry, and FX degradation isolated from overall status

summary.label: Changelog and navigation
summary.description: Weekly changelog page with timeline layout, collapsible sidebar groups, and a two-column API reference with scrollspy and method badges
